title: Children may treat dishwasher tablets and medicines as food
summary: UNICEF says curious children may mistake medicine or cleaning products, such as dishwasher tablets, for food.
body: UNICEF's babyproofing page says children are naturally curious and may mistake medicine or cleaning products, such as dishwasher tablets, for food. It says to store medicines, cleaning products, and chemicals in locked or high cupboards, to keep them in the original labelled containers, and never to store chemicals in drink bottles or food containers. Child-resistant caps help when they exist. The page does not print a telephone number, so this card does not invent one. The US poison line 800-222-1222 is only what the CPSC page prints, and the UK first-aid card uses 999 or 112. Those are different countries.
